question: 47 + 58 − 39 + 66 × 2 − (29 + 12) = ?
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option i.e. 157.

GIVEN

• 47 + 58 − 39 + 66 × 2 − (29 + 12)

SOLUTION

• Bracket: (29 + 12) = 41

• Multiply: 66 × 2 = 132

• 47 + 58 − 39 + 132 − 41 = 105 − 39 + 132 − 41 = 66 + 132 − 41 = 198 − 41 = 157.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option.

SHORT TRICK

• Apply BODMAS by grouping: (47 + 58 + 132) − (39 + 41) = 237 − 80 = 157.

NOTE

• Always resolve Brackets → Of/Orders → Division/Multiplication → Addition/Subtraction (BODMAS) strictly left to right.

question: 71 + 36 − (28 + 14) + 95 − 53 + 24 = ?
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option i.e. 131.

GIVEN

• 71 + 36 − (28 + 14) + 95 − 53 + 24

SOLUTION

• Bracket: (28 + 14) = 42

• 71 + 36 − 42 + 95 − 53 + 24 = 107 − 42 + 95 − 53 + 24 = 65 + 95 − 53 + 24 = 160 − 53 + 24 = 107 + 24 = 131.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option.

SHORT TRICK

• Add positives and negatives separately: (71 + 36 + 95 + 24) − (42 + 53) = 226 − 95 = 131.

NOTE

• Solve inner brackets first, then combine like signs to reduce calculation errors.

question: 91 + (28 × 1) − 34 + 29 + 17 ÷ 1 − 26 = ?
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option i.e. 105.

GIVEN

• 91 + (28 × 1) − 34 + 29 + 17 ÷ 1 − 26

SOLUTION

• 28 × 1 = 28 and 17 ÷ 1 = 17

• 91 + 28 − 34 + 29 + 17 − 26 = 119 − 34 + 29 + 17 − 26 = 85 + 29 + 17 − 26 = 114 + 17 − 26 = 131 − 26 = 105.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option.

SHORT TRICK

• Multiplying/dividing by 1 leaves values unchanged; group: (91 + 28 + 29 + 17) − (34 + 26) = 165 − 60 = 105.

NOTE

• Any number × 1 or ÷ 1 equals itself; simplify these before applying BODMAS.

question: A 40-litres mixture of acid and water contains acid and water in the ratio 3:1. 8 litres of this mixture is removed and replaced with another solution of acid and water in the ratio 1:3. What is the final ratio of acid to water in the resulting mixture?
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option i.e. 13:7.

GIVEN

• 40 L mixture, acid : water = 3 : 1; remove 8 L, add 8 L of acid : water = 1 : 3

SOLUTION

• Initial acid = 40 × 3/4 = 30 L, water = 10 L.

• 8 L removed (same 3:1 ratio) takes acid = 6 L, water = 2 L → remaining acid = 24 L, water = 8 L.

• Added 8 L (1:3) gives acid = 2 L, water = 6 L.

• Final acid = 26 L, water = 14 L → 26 : 14 = 13 : 7.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option.

SHORT TRICK

• Removing a fraction keeps the ratio; only track the net acid/water added. Acid: 30 − 6 + 2 = 26, Water: 10 − 2 + 6 = 14 → 13:7.

NOTE

• When part of a uniform mixture is removed, each component drops in the same original proportion.

question: Rajesh purchases 30 dozen pens at a rate of Rs 475 per dozen. He sells each pen for Rs 66. What is his total profit or loss percentage?
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option i.e. 66.73%.

GIVEN

• 30 dozen pens at Rs. 475/dozen; SP = Rs. 66 per pen

SOLUTION

• Total CP = 30 × 475 = Rs. 14,250.

• Total pens = 30 × 12 = 360; Total SP = 360 × 66 = Rs. 23,760.

• Profit = 23,760 − 14,250 = Rs. 9,510.

• Profit % = 9,510 ÷ 14,250 × 100 = 66.7368… ≈ 66.73%.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option.

SHORT TRICK

• Per dozen: CP = 475, SP = 12 × 66 = 792. Profit% = (792 − 475)/475 × 100 = 317/475 × 100 ≈ 66.73%.

NOTE

• Profit % = (Profit ÷ Cost Price) × 100; keep CP and SP on the same unit (per dozen or per pen).

question: If a:b=3:4 and b:c=5:7, find the ratio a:c.
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option i.e. 15:28.

GIVEN

• a : b = 3 : 4 and b : c = 5 : 7

SOLUTION

• a : c = (a : b) × (b : c) combining through b.

• Multiply the a-terms and c-terms: a : c = (3 × 5) : (4 × 7) = 15 : 28.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option.

SHORT TRICK

• To chain a:b and b:c, just cross-multiply: numerator = a-part × b-part of second, denominator = b-part of first × c-part → 3×5 : 4×7 = 15:28.

NOTE

• To combine ratios, make the common term (b) equal, or directly multiply outer terms when the link cancels.

question: A student was supposed to multiply a number by 19/18 but instead multiplied it by 9/8. Find the percentage error in the student's calculation.
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option i.e. 6.58%.

GIVEN

• Correct multiplier = 19/18, wrong multiplier = 9/8

SOLUTION

• Error in factor = 9/8 − 19/18. LCM = 72 → 81/72 − 76/72 = 5/72.

• % error = (error ÷ correct value) × 100 = (5/72) ÷ (19/18) × 100.

• = (5/72) × (18/19) × 100 = 90/1368 × 100 = 6.578… ≈ 6.58%.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option.

SHORT TRICK

• Take number = 72 (LCM). Correct = 72 × 19/18 = 76, Wrong = 72 × 9/8 = 81. Error % = (81 − 76)/76 × 100 = 5/76 × 100 ≈ 6.58%.

NOTE

• Percentage error = (|Wrong − Correct| ÷ Correct) × 100, always taken on the correct value.

question: A and B start a business with investments of Rs. 18,000 and Rs. 24,000, respectively. If the profit-sharing ratio is 3 : 4, determine the ratio of the time periods for which A and B invested.
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option i.e. 1 : 1.

GIVEN

• Investments: A = Rs. 18,000, B = Rs. 24,000; Profit ratio = 3 : 4

SOLUTION

• Profit ∝ Investment × Time, so 3 : 4 = (18000 × t_A) : (24000 × t_B).

• (18000 t_A)/(24000 t_B) = 3/4 → (3 t_A)/(4 t_B) = 3/4 → t_A/t_B = 1.

• Ratio of time periods = 1 : 1.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option.

SHORT TRICK

• Investment ratio 18000:24000 = 3:4 already equals profit ratio 3:4, so time ratio must be 1:1.

NOTE

• In partnership, Profit share ∝ (Capital × Time). If capital ratio = profit ratio, time ratio is 1:1.

question: A square field has an area equal to that of a rectangle of dimensions 36 m × 49 m. Find the side of the square.
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option i.e. 42 meters.

GIVEN

• Square area = Rectangle area = 36 m × 49 m

SOLUTION

• Rectangle area = 36 × 49 = 1764 m².

• Side of square = √1764 = √(36 × 49) = 6 × 7 = 42 meters.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option.

SHORT TRICK

• √(36 × 49) = √36 × √49 = 6 × 7 = 42 m, no need to multiply out to 1764.

NOTE

• Side of a square = √(Area). Splitting a product into perfect-square factors speeds up the square root.

question: A three-digit number is such that the sum of the number and its square root is 132. Find the number.
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option i.e. 121.

GIVEN

• Number + √(Number) = 132

SOLUTION

• The number must be a perfect square (for a whole square root). Among options, 121 = 11².

• 121 + √121 = 121 + 11 = 132. ✓

• Hence the number = 121.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option.

SHORT TRICK

• Only 121 is a perfect square in the options; check it directly: 121 + 11 = 132.

NOTE

• For 'number + its square root', test only the perfect-square options to save time.

question: A man spends 83% of his income. If his income increases by 23% and his expenditure increases by 13%, find the percentage increase in his savings.
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option i.e. 71.82%.

GIVEN

• Expenditure = 83% of income; income ↑ 23%, expenditure ↑ 13%

SOLUTION

• Let income = 100 → expenditure = 83, savings = 17.

• New income = 123; new expenditure = 83 × 1.13 = 93.79.

• New savings = 123 − 93.79 = 29.21.

• % increase = (29.21 − 17)/17 × 100 = 12.21/17 × 100 = 71.82%.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option.

SHORT TRICK

• Savings increase = (New savings − Old savings)/Old savings × 100 = (29.21 − 17)/17 × 100 ≈ 71.82%.

NOTE

• Savings = Income − Expenditure. Assume income = 100 to convert percentage changes into direct numbers.

question: Which of the following is greater than ?
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option i.e. 70/80.

GIVEN

• Reference fraction = 84/108

SOLUTION

• 84/108 = 0.777… (7/9).

• 42/60 = 0.700; 70/80 = 0.875; 14/25 = 0.560; 21/40 = 0.525.

• Only 0.875 > 0.777, so 70/80 is greater.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option.

SHORT TRICK

• Convert each to a decimal (or compare to ≈0.78). 70/80 = 7/8 = 0.875 is clearly the only one above it.

NOTE

• To compare fractions quickly, reduce them and convert to decimals, or cross-multiply against the reference.

question: 10.5 − (9.75 − 4.25 − 3.50) = ?
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option i.e. 8.5.

GIVEN

• 10.5 − (9.75 − 4.25 − 3.50)

SOLUTION

• Inside bracket: 9.75 − 4.25 − 3.50 = 5.50 − 3.50 = 2.00.

• 10.5 − 2.0 = 8.5.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option.

SHORT TRICK

• 4.25 + 3.50 = 7.75, so bracket = 9.75 − 7.75 = 2; then 10.5 − 2 = 8.5.

NOTE

• Resolve the innermost bracket first; a minus sign before a bracket flips each inner operation only after the bracket is simplified.

question: The product of two consecutive odd numbers is 323. What is the sum of the two numbers?
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option i.e. 36.

GIVEN

• Two consecutive odd numbers with product 323

SOLUTION

• √323 ≈ 17.97, so the numbers are around 18 → 17 and 19.

• 17 × 19 = 323. ✓

• Sum = 17 + 19 = 36.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option.

SHORT TRICK

• 17 × 19 = 18² − 1 = 324 − 1 = 323; the two numbers are 17 and 19, sum = 2 × 18 = 36.

NOTE

• For n−1 and n+1 (odd pair around even n), product = n² − 1 and sum = 2n.

question: The sum of a positive number and its square is 90. What is the value of the number?
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option i.e. 9.

GIVEN

• Number + (Number)² = 90

SOLUTION

• Let the number = x → x + x² = 90 → x² + x − 90 = 0.

• (x + 10)(x − 9) = 0 → x = 9 (positive).

• Check: 9 + 81 = 90. ✓ Number = 9.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option.

SHORT TRICK

• Test options: 9 + 9² = 9 + 81 = 90 instantly matches.

NOTE

• x² + x − 90 = 0 factors as (x + 10)(x − 9); reject the negative root for a positive number.

question: Which of the following number is NOT divisible by 4?
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option i.e. 4951.

GIVEN

• Find the number NOT divisible by 4

SOLUTION

• A number is divisible by 4 if its last two digits form a multiple of 4.

• 44 ÷ 4 = 11 ✓ (4844), 32 ÷ 4 = 8 ✓ (4732), 12 ÷ 4 = 3 ✓ (4612).

• 51 is odd and not a multiple of 4, so 4951 is NOT divisible by 4.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option.

SHORT TRICK

• 4951 is odd; odd numbers can never be divisible by 4, so pick it immediately.

NOTE

• Divisibility by 4: check whether the last two digits are divisible by 4.

question: Which of the following number is divisible by both 3 and 4?
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option i.e. 10320.

GIVEN

• Find the number divisible by both 3 and 4 (i.e. by 12)

SOLUTION

• Divisible by 4: last two digits 20 ÷ 4 = 5 ✓ for 10320.

• Divisible by 3: digit sum 1+0+3+2+0 = 6, divisible by 3 ✓.

• Others fail: 8235, 8491 are odd (not by 4); 7582 digit sum 22 (not by 3).

• So 10320 is divisible by both.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option.

SHORT TRICK

• Eliminate odd numbers first (fail by 4), then test the digit sum for divisibility by 3 → 10320 survives.

NOTE

• Divisible by 3 → digit sum divisible by 3; divisible by 4 → last two digits divisible by 4.

question: Average of first 'N' even natural numbers is 55. What is the value of 'N'?
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option i.e. 54.

GIVEN

• Average of first N even natural numbers = 55

SOLUTION

• Sum of first N even numbers = N(N+1); average = N(N+1)/N = (N+1).

• So N + 1 = 55 → N = 54.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option.

SHORT TRICK

• Average of first N even natural numbers is simply (N + 1); set N + 1 = 55 → N = 54.

NOTE

• First N even numbers: average = N + 1. First N odd numbers: average = N.

question: Average of 30 observations is 60. Average of first 15 observations is 62. Average of last 16 observations is 55. What is the value of 15th observation?
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option i.e. 10.

GIVEN

• Total obs = 30, mean 60; first 15 mean 62; last 16 mean 55

SOLUTION

• Total sum = 30 × 60 = 1800.

• Sum of first 15 = 15 × 62 = 930; sum of last 16 = 16 × 55 = 880.

• First 15 (obs 1–15) + last 16 (obs 15–30) overlap only at the 15th observation.

• 930 + 880 = 1800 + (15th) → 1810 = 1800 + (15th) → 15th = 10.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option.

SHORT TRICK

• Overlap term = (sum of the two groups) − total = (930 + 880) − 1800 = 10.

NOTE

• When two overlapping groups cover all items, the shared item = (sum of group sums) − (grand total).

question: What will be the average of all the odd natural numbers between 6 and 44?
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option i.e. 25.

GIVEN

• Odd natural numbers between 6 and 44

SOLUTION

• The odd numbers are 7, 9, 11, …, 43 (an arithmetic progression).

• For an evenly-spaced set, average = (first + last)/2 = (7 + 43)/2.

• = 50/2 = 25.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option.

SHORT TRICK

• For consecutive odd numbers, average = (first + last)/2 = (7 + 43)/2 = 25.

NOTE

• The average of any arithmetic progression equals the mean of its first and last terms.
